en: \[Remote Control] Fixed the diff view in Remote Control sessions on claude.ai and the desktop app showing deleted and renamed files as modified; requires Claude Code v2.1.296 or later on your machine
zh: \[Remote Control] 修复了 claude.ai 和桌面应用上 Remote Control sessions 的 diff 视图将已删除和已重命名的文件显示为已修改的问题；需要本机 Claude Code v2.1.296 或更高版本
